title: Vijaya Offset Printers vs Greenfield Public School
nature: suit for recovery of Rs. 6,84,500 with interest
summary: Printer supplied textbooks and notebooks for 2023-24; school paid nothing on 14 invoices.

hearings.order_sheet: Defendant appeared through counsel. Time for written statement. For written statement on 28.07.2025.
hearings.note: Greenfield school (OS 88/25) - Bhaskar for school. Time for WS.

hearings.order_sheet: Written statement not filed. Time sought. Adjourned with a direction to file the written statement positively by the next date. For written statement on 08.09.2025.
hearings.note: Greenfield - WS not filed. Bhaskar's junior said sir is unwell. Murthy sir: 'positively by next date.'

hearings.order_sheet: Written statement filed with a petition to condone delay. Delay condoned subject to costs of Rs. 1,000 payable to plaintiff. For framing of issues on 03.11.2025.
hearings.note: Greenfield - WS filed late with delay petition; Murthy sir condoned delay but Rs 1,000 costs to us. WS says books had 'printing defects', but they never returned a single book!

hearings.order_sheet: Issues framed. For plaintiff's evidence on 12.01.2026.
hearings.note: Greenfield - issues framed. Murali garu's chief affidavit to be ready - invoices, delivery challans signed by school clerk, 3 reminder letters.

hearings.order_sheet: PW1 examined in chief by affidavit. Ex.A1 to A20 marked. For cross-examination of PW1 on 23.02.2026.
hearings.note: PW1 Murali Krishna Pydi chief. Ex.A1-A14 invoices (total Rs. 6,84,500), Ex.A15-A17 delivery challans signed by school office, Ex.A18-A20 reminder letters. Purchase order dt. 04.04.2023 is Ex.A1 annexure.

hearings.order_sheet: Counsel for defendant absent. Junior counsel seeks time for cross-examination of PW1. Adjourned. For cross-examination of PW1 on 20.04.2026.
hearings.note: Greenfield - Bhaskar absent (1st adjournment for cross). Junior asked time. Granted. Murali garu lost a day of work again.

hearings.order_sheet: Counsel for defendant reported to be unwell. Adjourned as a last opportunity for cross-examination of PW1. For cross-examination of PW1 on 22.06.2026.
hearings.note: Greenfield - Bhaskar 'unwell' (2nd time). Murthy sir: 'LAST opportunity.' Saw Bhaskar in the bar association canteen at 1.30 pm the same day. Noting it.

hearings.order_sheet: Counsel for defendant again seeks adjournment. Request rejected. Cross-examination of PW1 treated as nil. Costs of Rs. 3,000 imposed on defendant payable to plaintiff. For defendant's evidence on 03.08.2026.
hearings.note: Greenfield - 3rd adjournment request. Murthy sir REJECTED it, cross of PW1 closed as nil, Rs 3,000 costs. Said: 'If counsel is unwell every alternate hearing, the client should engage another counsel.' Same as he did in Seabreeze (Rs 2,000 costs for irregular filing). His pattern: 2nd time 'last opportunity', 3rd time costs.

hearings.order_sheet: DW1 examined in chief by affidavit. For cross-examination of DW1 on 14.09.2026.
hearings.note: Greenfield - DW1 school correspondent K. Jagan Mohan. Chief: printing defects, pages missing in class 7 maths books.

hearings.order_sheet: DW1 cross-examined. Evidence on both sides closed. For arguments on 05.10.2026.
hearings.note: Greenfield - DW1 cross. Admitted: all books were distributed to students in June 2023; not one returned; no written complaint ever sent to the printer. For arguments on 5 Oct - written arguments ready by 1 Oct (Divya drafts, I finalise).
